data.body: Completion evidence — Gerrit change 2794 passed `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1` with zero unresolved comments, then merged via a trivial server-side rebase as `92bfc4d3919072daa85fbd5664489d3b95693bd0` (reviewed SHA `4ed40a4fbf15831d333fa21c41eefd8a8d0f8013`; CI run 34148697654, 1,781 seconds, 20 success / 2 skipped / 0 failed). Exactly 96 allowlisted blocks changed across the 18 owned paths (55 docstrings, 41 full-line comment regions), and every block became shorter: 12,575 → 2,475 words, removing 10,100. Frozen-basis proof passed for normalized executable AST equivalence, unchanged protected prose and inline comments, exact attachment/text for all 10 directives and the shebang, exact path scope, and owned-span-only hunks. Focused consumers passed 3,820 tests with one expected skip; scoped Ruff/format, comment hygiene, and diff integrity passed. The independent reviewer manually checked all 18 files and posted one read-back-verified receipt with 96 unique fully cited rows × 10 columns, every row shorter and all three verdicts PASS. Per the user's documentation-only verification direction, Gerrit Verified supplies the repository-wide gate; no local `make verify` was run.
